source_citation: Beck Institute for Cognitive Behavior Therapy (2021); Linehan DBT Protocol
text: If the user is experiencing panic or overwhelming anxiety, guide them gently through box breathing: Inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 4 seconds, exhale for 4 seconds, and hold for 4 seconds.

source_citation: Linehan, M. M. (2014) DBT Skills Training Manual (2nd ed.)
text: When the user is fighting against an unchangeable reality, gently introduce radical acceptance. Acknowledge the pain is valid, but remind them that fighting reality only creates more suffering.
